buildingfoundations.title: Building Your Foundation
buildingfoundations.author: Mat Harvey
buildingfoundations.excerpt: Basic motor patterns lay the foundations of all physical performance and health. Developing sound basic movement patterns takes persistence and often a temporary reduction in intensity.

firstmu.title: The Road to My First Ring Muscle Up
firstmu.author: Mat Harvey
firstmu.excerpt: I didn't do gymnastics as a child, I learned all this stuff as an adult. Now I can complete a ring muscle up, cold, anytime. The process takes dedication, consistency and patience.

trainingandpain.title: Training and Pain
trainingandpain.author: Mat Harvey
trainingandpain.excerpt: Training should not hurt. Nope, not ever. Training should certainly be uncomfortable, often. But training should not ever cause acute or chronic pain.

strengthtrainingandrecovery.title: Strength Training and Recovery
strengthtrainingandrecovery.author: Mat Harvey
strengthtrainingandrecovery.excerpt: You don't get strong in the gym. You get strong while you are in bed, asleep with a full stomach, otherwise known as recovery.

goalsetting.title: 8 Tips for Healthy Goal Setting
goalsetting.author: Mat Harvey
goalsetting.excerpt: Do you work out to get high? Does that progress towards your goals? Many people enjoy the runner's high but this style of training must align with your goals.

fiveprinicipalsofstrengthtraining.title: 5 Principles of Strength Training
fiveprinicipalsofstrengthtraining.author: Mat Harvey
fiveprinicipalsofstrengthtraining.excerpt: Bodyweight strength training is a noble pursuit, it requires patience, understanding of your own body and mental fortitude.
